job.title: AI Full Stack Engineer – Service Technology @ Caterpillar (TN, IN)
job.description:
**Career Area:**

Technology, Digital and Data

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**Role Description**

Design, develop, test, deploy, and support scalable enterprise applications using modern full-stack technologies.  
Apply an **AI-first engineering approach**, leveraging approved AI coding harnesses and agents throughout requirements, design, development, testing, review, and troubleshooting.  
Develop secure, reliable applications, APIs, integrations, and distributed processing systems for internal platforms such as Remote Service.  
Own solutions from Design through production, ensuring **quality, performance, security, and maintainability**.

This is not a prompt-engineering-only role. You'll write production code, make architectural decisions, and set engineering patterns that move AI-enabled systems from concept to production. All this work must meet enterprise standards for security, compliance, performance, and responsible AI. Caterpillar will equip this role with modern AI engineering tools, including GitHub Copilot and current models and platforms from Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI, and other leading providers, based on enterprise approval and fit for purpose.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Full-Stack Development:** Design and develop responsive web applications using modern technologies such as **Angular, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java/Spring Boot**.
* **AI-First Engineering:** Effectively use **AI coding Agentic systems** to accelerate requirements analysis, solution design, code development, refactoring, debugging, documentation, and modernization.
* **Agentic Development:** Decompose engineering work into features that AI agents can execute, provide appropriate application and architectural context, and **critically review and validate AI-generated solutions**.
* **API & Integration Engineering:** Design and develop secure **REST APIs, microservices, asynchronous/event-driven integrations, batch processing, and enterprise system integrations** required by applications such as FIDS2.0.
* **Data Engineering:** Develop efficient data-access solutions using **Oracle, SQL DB, and query optimization**.
* **Quality Engineering:** Build comprehensive **unit, integration, API, UI automation, regression, and performance tests**, leveraging AI to improve test coverage and accelerate defect identification.
* **Production Engineering & Observability:** Build applications for production reliability using structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, **OpenTelemetry**, monitoring, performance analysis, and AI-assisted root-cause analysis.
* **AI-Enabled Applications:** Develop AI capabilities into the target application, where appropriate using **LLMs, RAG, context engineering, agentic workflows, evaluation, grounding, and guardrails**, while maintaining enterprise security and governance.

**Required**

* Bachelor's/master’s degree in computer science, Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
* **8+ years** of professional software development experience as a full stack developer, with at least 2 years hands on experience with AI/Gen AI/Agentic AI systems.
* Strong full-stack development experience.
* Strong proficiency in at least one enterprise backend technology.
* Strong JavaScript/TypeScript and modern UI framework experience.
* Experience designing and consuming REST APIs.
* Strong SQL/database fundamentals.
* Experience with Git and modern CI/CD practices.
* Experience with automated software testing.
* Practical experience using **AI coding assistants or coding agents as part of normal software development**.
* Demonstrated ability to review, debug and validate AI-generated code.

**Considerations for Top Candidates:**

* Experience building large enterprise or distributed applications.
* Experience with high-volume asynchronous or batch processing.
* Experience integrating LLM/AI capabilities into production applications.
* RAG/vector-search experience.
* Agentic AI development experience.
* Experience building or configuring specialized AI software-engineering agents.

**Posting Dates:**

November 16, 2026 - November 29, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

* Implement resiliency and security patterns (retry, circuit breaker, idempotency, least privilege).

**Modern Web Development**

* Build responsive, accessible **Angular (v16+)** applications and MFEs using RxJS and modern UI patterns.
* Integrate front‑end applications with backend services using typed clients.

**AI‑Accelerated Engineering**

* Use AI developer tools to accelerate code generation, refactoring, testing, documentation, and reviews (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, CodeWhisperer).
* Apply human judgment and engineering standards to ensure correctness and security.
* Demonstrate measurable improvements in delivery efficiency and quality.

**Full SDLC Ownership**

* Author unit, integration, and E2E tests (xUnit/NUnit, Testcontainers, Playwright/Cypress).
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with automated quality and security gates.
* Instrument applications with logging, metrics, tracing, and operational dashboards.

Required Qualifications

* 5+ years of hands‑on full‑stack software development experience.
* 5+ years of experience designing and implementing complex, distributed systems.
* Strong experience with **.NET/C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, AWS, SQL & NoSQL**.
* 5+ years of AWS cloud development and deployment experience, including **EKS, RDS/Aurora, S3, Athena, Glue, and EventBridge**.
* Experience building ETL and data pipelines from structured and unstructured sources.

Required Tools & Platforms

* Git‑based source control and pull‑request workflows.
* Agile tools such as **Jira** (or equivalent).

* API testing tools such as **Postman**.
* Code quality and security tools such as **SonarQube/SonarLint** and **Snyk**.
* AI‑assisted development tools such as **GitHub Copilot/Copilot Chat**, **Cursor**, or similar.

Preferred Qualifications

* Reporting and data experience; Python (PySpark/NumPy) a plus.

Core Competencies

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.

At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

**Overview**

Boeing is the world's largest aerospace company and leading manufacturer of commercial airplanes and defense, space and security systems. We are engineers and technicians. Skilled scientists and thinkers. Bold innovators and dreamers. Join us, and you can build something better for yourself, for our customers and for the world.

As a leading global aerospace company, Boeing develops, manufactures and services commercial airplanes, defense products and space systems for customers in more than 150 countries. As a top U.S. exporter, the company leverages the talents of a global supplier base to advance economic opportunity, sustainability and community impact. Experience with cloud platforms, particularly AWS (S3, EMR, Glue, Lambda). Experience with modern DevOps tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform.
